content.short: Menthol Protocol provides the first multi-chain decentralized sustainability ecosystem to transition toward climate-positive crypto.
content.description: Menthol Protocol is a multi-chain decentralized sustainability protocol that automatically offsets the carbon emissions generated by user or dApp transactions using verified renewable energy and globally sourced carbon credits. It aims to support major dApps and enable both developers and users to become climate-positive in a decentralized and automated manner. Built to be highly composable and pluggable, Menthol Protocol aspires to serve as the core middleware for sustainability across DeFi and NFT ecosystems.
content.meta: Menthol Protocol offsets carbon emissions from transactions with carbon credits. Discover Menthol Protocol and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
